verdict: Section E is unusually specific and most of it is traceable to the logo (the hue-walk ramp, graphite-majority surface, hairline seams, the pedestal field, the faceted icon lattice), and its contrast arithmetic checks out (I recomputed mist/graphite 16.3:1, amber 7.3:1, blue 3.9:1). But three load-bearing claims are false or infeasible as written: (1) the "interim cutout" of the source PNG cannot be done losslessly — the backdrop is a 234–251 gradient with a soft contact shadow under the base (to y≈1018) and the plate's top face sits at ≈225, so an alpha key fringes or eats the plate, and the stated crop (x 306–882, y 30–1000) clips the base plate (which reaches x≈893) — shipping that violates §02; (2) the shared-vertex mesh model (`pos: N·3`, "morph is purely per-vertex") is incompatible with the per-triangle rotation, FRAGMENTS offsets and NETWORK "enlarged node triangles" the same section promises; (3) "prefix of a Bridson sampling order" is not a uniform subset (Bridson grows outward from a seed), uniform Poisson sampling gives no facet-size gradient, and a Delaunay of a superset is not a refinement of the subset — so the depth cue, the profile-downgrade coherence and the "poster is the live mesh" identity all rest on a sampler that does not behave as described. Beyond those, the ramp orientation puts cyan on the right (the logo is cool on the left), gold is used far beyond §03's "occasional", per-frame React props violate §22, mobile recomposition (§24) is absent, the hero state has zero translucency despite §01/§05, and several numbers (depth units, probe timing, icon stroke at 24 px, phone budgets) would stall a builder. With the fixes below the section is sound and distinctly Shakir; without them Milestones 1–3 would be built on a model that has to be rewritten.

issues.problem: E.6 interim logo handling violates §02 (do not distort / change proportions). Measured: the backdrop is not flat #EDEDED but a gradient from (237,237,237) at the top to (247–251) at the bottom-left, with a soft contact shadow under the base plate running to y≈1018; the plate's lit top face is ≈(225,225,223), within 4–20 levels of the surrounding backdrop; the plate extends to x≈893 on rows 969–981, so the stated crop x 306–882 cuts ~11 px off the plate, and the crop at y 1000 cuts the shadow mid-gradient. A 'lossless alpha key of the flat backdrop' is therefore impossible: it either leaves a grey fringe on every edge and a grey smear under the base, or removes part of the plate. Also `aspect-ratio: 576 / 970` is hard-coded from this damaged crop, so the client's real asset (different padding) will not fit the reserved box.
issues.fix: Delete the interim cutout entirely. Interim rule: the source PNG is shown only uncut, inside a deliberately designed light 'plinth' tile — `background: #EDEDED`, `border-radius: 24px`, crop x 290–920 × y 20–1024 (630×1004; keeps plate and shadow, excludes the watermark at x≈940–1000, y≈953–981) — used in nav (as a 40 px tile), loading screen and footer only. Hero, IntroSequence (mask-image light pass), ShakirOne lens and Final CTA are declared blocked on client asset (1) transparent PNG 2048² and (2) SVG master; list that dependency in Milestone 1 week 1 and in section M. `Logo` reads intrinsic width/height from the asset (next/image `width`/`height` from import metadata) and sets `aspect-ratio` from them; never hard-code 576/970.

issues.problem: E.3 mesh model is internally infeasible. `SceneState.pos` is a shared-vertex array (N·3) and the blend is 'purely per-vertex … no reindexing', yet E.1/E.3 require operations that only work on unshared corners: idle per-triangle rotation about centroids (HIGH), FRAGMENTS 'each triangle offset along its radial vector and rotated ±18°', NETWORK 'node triangles enlarged'. With shared vertices a triangle cannot move independently of its neighbours; rotating/offsetting per triangle opens gaps between facets and is not representable in `pos`.
issues.fix: Store corner positions unshared: `SceneState.cpos: Float32Array // T·9 (x,y,z per corner)` (2,400×9×4 B = 86 KB per state, 690 KB for 8 states at HIGH — acceptable). Generators that are landscape-like (MOUNTAIN, UNIVERSE, ONE_CORE, INTERFACE) write shared-vertex positions and scatter them into `cpos`; FRAGMENTS, NETWORK and the idle rotation write `cpos` directly. The frame is `cpos = mix(a.cpos, b.cpos, e)` — still a lerp with identical lengths. Keep `points`/`tris` in `MeshTopology` only for Delaunay, centroids and banding. Rewrite the memory figure (≈ 0.9 MB at HIGH) and the per-frame op count accordingly.

issues.problem: E.3 point-set and E.5 identity rest on three false claims: (a) 'points [0,300) are the LOW set, [0,620) MEDIUM' — a prefix of a Bridson Poisson-disc sequence is a connected blob growing from the seed point, not uniform coverage, so LOW/downgrade meshes would cover a patch of the viewport; (b) uniform-radius Poisson sampling produces near-equal triangle areas, so 'band by facet area tercile' cannot yield the 2.5–4 / 4.5–7 / 8–12 vh size bands of E.1 (the stated primary depth cue) and 'tercile' also contradicts the 50/35/15 split; (c) the Delaunay triangulation of a superset is not a subdivision of the subset's triangulation, so 'facets subdivide; nothing jumps' on poster→canvas and on profile downgrade is untrue.
issues.fix: (a)+(b) Use a nested, density-graded sampler in `lib/lowpoly/sample.ts`: a depth field `D(x,y) ∈ [0,1]` per state family (for MOUNTAIN: 1 at the horizon band 50–62 vh, 0 at the bottom edge), radius `r = lerp(rFront, rBack, D)` with (rFront, rBack) = (10 vh, 3 vh) at HIGH, (13, 4.5) MEDIUM, (18, 6) LOW; generate LOW first, then run Bridson for MEDIUM seeded with the LOW points as the initial active list, then HIGH seeded with MEDIUM — each level is a uniform superset of the previous (true nested refinement). Assign `band` from `D` at the centroid (D > 0.66 BACK, > 0.33 MID, else FRONT) and tune thresholds to the 50/35/15 share. (c) Drop the 'nothing jumps' claim; keep the 300 ms crossfade and state honestly that colour continuity (centroid-based) is preserved while edges re-triangulate. If a true subdivision is later wanted, note `cdt2d` (constrained Delaunay, ≈ 8 KB gz) as the only path, not `delaunator`.

issues.problem: E.1 ramp orientation is reversed relative to the logo. `u = atan2(cy − hy, cx − hx)/2π + seedOffset` puts u = 0 (cyan) at angle 0, i.e. to the RIGHT of the hub in canvas coordinates, whereas the logo is cool on the LEFT (thumb, left finger), gold at the TOP (crown), red/magenta on the RIGHT and violet/blue at the BOTTOM. An unspecified `seedOffset` that varies with `seed` would also rotate the rainbow per seed, destroying the 'logo order' rule this whole section is built on.
issues.fix: Fix the orientation and remove the seed from it: `u = (atan2(cy − hy, cx − hx) / 2π + 0.5 + 0.06·noise(centroid)) mod 1` in canvas (y-down) coordinates, which gives left = 0.00 cyan, top = 0.25, right = 0.50, bottom = 0.75. Then move the ramp stops to match the logo's quadrants: cyan 0.00 → teal 0.10 → gold 0.22 → amber 0.33 → peach 0.42 → magenta 0.52 → violet 0.70 → blue 0.88 → wrap. `seed` affects noise only, never the ramp phase. Update the per-world slice table to the new stop values.

issues.problem: Gold overuse contradicts §03 ('occasional peach/gold', 'warm amber'). The draft makes gold/crown-gold the hub core, the ONE_CORE inner ring, the 24/12-facet lens, the ground reflection under the logo, the beam arrival colour, the eyebrow-label text colour, the BUILD & GROW primary, and HUMAN's secondary — gold is the most-seen accent on the page, which also pushes toward 'generic premium-tech' gold-on-black.
issues.fix: Reserve gold strictly for logo-adjacent moments: ShakirOne lens, SYMBOL ring, beam arrival at the crown, ground reflection. Everywhere else: eyebrow labels use `--mist-60`; BUILD & GROW = amber primary / gold secondary with the gold capped at 30 % of that world's accent facets; HUMAN = peach primary / amber secondary (no gold). Add a one-line rule to E.2: 'gold may appear in at most one element per viewport outside ShakirOne and the Final CTA'.

issues.problem: §24 'Mobile: do NOT simply shrink desktop. Recompose scenes' is not addressed in scope. E only changes facet edge lengths and caps the profile; the state generators carry a `viewport` argument but no portrait composition rules: MOUNTAIN horizon at 58 vh and 'valley under the logo footprint' assume the desktop right-5/12 logo; INTERFACE snaps to a 12-column grid (impossible at 390 px); UNIVERSE's 6 rings and ONE_CORE's 1.9×/2.6× orbits are landscape radii; the hub position on portrait is never given.
issues.fix: Add a 'portrait composition' column to the state table (breakpoint: `aspect < 1`): MOUNTAIN hub at (0.5, 0.36) under the centred logo, horizon 44 vh, valley 1.3× logo width centred; FRAGMENTS/NETWORK hub (0.5, 0.45); INTERFACE 4-column grid, 2 stacked panels; UNIVERSE ring radii 0.18/0.26/0.34/0.42/0.50/0.58 × vw (desktop uses × vh); ENGINE spiral centre (0.5, 0.5); ONE_CORE orbits 1.6×/2.2× mark height; SYMBOL ring radius 0.40 × vw. Tablet (768–1024) uses the desktop composition at MEDIUM. Posters' mobile crop is generated from the portrait composition, not a crop of the desktop one.

issues.problem: §22 'no unnecessary React rerenders' is violated by the LowPolyScene API: `state: { from, to, t }` and `beam: { headX, headY, u, width }` are React props that change every frame during a scrubbed scroll (60×/s), re-rendering the component tree; ShakirBeam 'reports back to LowPolyScene every frame' and 'reads beamPath from the current blended state' with no interface for either direction.
issues.fix: Split the API: static config stays as props (`intensity`, `density`, `depth`, `motion`, `palette`, `interactive`, `performanceLevel`, `seed`, `poster`, `logoExclusion`, callbacks). Per-frame data goes through an imperative handle: `export type LowPolySceneHandle = { setProgress(from: SceneStateName, to: SceneStateName, t: number): void; setBeam(b: BeamState | null): void; setTextSafeZones(z: Rect[]): void; getBeamPath(): Float32Array; getHub(): [number, number]; }` exposed via `useImperativeHandle`; SceneController holds the ref and calls it from the ScrollTrigger `onUpdate`; ShakirBeam receives the same ref. Define `Rect = { x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number } // viewport fractions`, `BeamState = { headX: number; headY: number; u: number }` (drop unused `width`) and `MeshFrame`.

issues.problem: The hero state has none of the 'layered translucent triangles / crystalline surfaces' (§01) or 'refract light' (§05): translucency is allowed only in FRAGMENTS, UNIVERSE and ENGINE, so MOUNTAIN — the most-viewed state and the first impression — is fully opaque, and 'refraction' is reduced to the beam's 600 ms tint.
issues.fix: Allow a small crystalline set in MOUNTAIN: ≤ 40 FRONT-band accent facets within 1.6× the logo width of the hub at alpha 0.72, `source-over`, with the 2-layer rule unchanged; on MEDIUM ≤ 16, LOW/REDUCED_MOTION none. Add a static 'refraction' cue independent of the beam: facets whose quantised normal is within 18° of the key light get a second, 20 %-lighter sub-facet (a split along the longest edge) — computed once per state, no per-frame cost.

issues.problem: Perf claims are unverified and the phone budget is missing. '≈ 13 k float ops' at HIGH ignores per-triangle normals (≈ 48 k ops), beam distance (≈ 24 k), shatter noise per vertex per frame (≈ 125 k if noise is evaluated live) and per-triangle sin/cos — the real figure is 300–600 k ops. 'Measured budgets ~12–20 ms' for SVG and '4–6 ms / ≈ 9 ms' for Canvas are presented as measurements but are estimates. The frame-cost row covers only the reference laptop; MEDIUM — the profile every phone gets — has no phone figure, and 'mid-range phone at 60 fps' is the claim that matters.
issues.fix: Reword all numbers as estimates and make them Milestone 3 exit criteria. Name reference devices: laptop = MacBook Air M1 / 8th-gen i5 UHD 620; phone = Galaxy A14 (Mali-G52) and iPhone 11, both at MEDIUM, 390×844, DPR 1.25. Add a column 'Typical frame cost (reference phone)': MEDIUM ≤ 8 ms, LOW ≤ 4 ms, with a hard gate 'MEDIUM p75 ≤ 12 ms on Galaxy A14 while scrubbing'. Precompute the per-vertex shatter noise once (`shatterSeed: Float32Array N`) so only `sin(e·π)` is per frame; store per-triangle rotation phase and use a 256-entry sin LUT.

issues.problem: The grain overlay (`mix-blend-mode: overlay` over a canvas repainting every frame) forces an extra full-viewport compositing pass with blending on every frame; on MEDIUM this is every phone, where blend-mode layers over a live canvas are a known jank source. Also a grain layer above text would alter text colour.
issues.fix: Grain on HIGH only. Implement it inside the canvas as the last draw call of a frame (`ctx.globalAlpha = 0.035; ctx.fillStyle = grainPattern; ctx.fillRect(...)`) — one call, no CSS blend layer — and remove `mix-blend-mode` from the plan. Specify the layer stack explicitly: canvas (facets, particles, grain) → CSS fog gradient → ShakirBeam SVG → logo/text (with scrims) → CSS vignette.

issues.problem: The 1-second frame-time probe runs 300–1,300 ms after `onReady`, i.e. during IntroSequence's fragments/assembly phase, concurrent with hydration, font loading and poster image decode; p75 > 20 ms in that window will downgrade perfectly capable devices, and the resulting topology rebuild + 400 ms crossfade would occur mid-cinematic.
issues.fix: Probe window = 600–1,600 ms after `onReady` AND after `document.fonts.ready`, sampling only frames where no React commit occurred (flag via a `useEffect` counter). Use p50 > 20 ms (one level) / p50 > 34 ms (two levels). Never rebuild during the intro: queue the downgrade and apply it at the intro→hero dissolve (section F's 300 ms overlay), where the crossfade is invisible.

issues.problem: Posters (and therefore the entire REDUCED_MOTION experience and the no-JS page) are generated at the LOW set (300 points ≈ 560 triangles). On a 1920×1080 desktop that is ≈ 110 px median edges — far coarser than the live MID band (40–63 px) — so reduced-motion users get a visibly cruder brand, and the first-paint → canvas handoff shows an obvious refinement pop on every HIGH desktop load.
issues.fix: Generate desktop posters at the MEDIUM set (620 points; SVG ≈ 35 KB gz) and mobile posters at LOW; REDUCED_MOTION on desktop uses the MEDIUM plates. Keep the AVIF LCP raster at MEDIUM too (≈ 90 KB). State the drift-guard comparison per set.

issues.problem: Two named states are geometrically unsound with a fixed Delaunay topology: INTERFACE 'vertices snap to a 12-column grid forming 3 panel rectangles' turns most of 1,250 points into collinear sets, producing thousands of zero-area slivers whose hairline seams stack into solid dark lines; SYMBOL 'all vertices collapse to a 12-facet ring' stacks ~2,400 triangles at the same pixels (overdraw + seams = a dark blob) unless alpha-0 triangles are skipped, which is not stated.
issues.fix: INTERFACE: snap vertices to the grid with ±3 px jitter and set `alpha = 0` for any triangle whose area falls below 15 % of its MOUNTAIN area; the three panel outlines are drawn by ShakirBeam's SVG, not by the mesh. SYMBOL: only the 24 ring-adjacent triangles get positions on the ring; all others keep their ONE_CORE positions and go alpha → 0. Add a renderer rule: triangles with alpha < 0.02 are skipped before batching, and degenerate triangles (area < 1 px²) are never stroked.

issues.problem: E.7 icon spec is not drawable at 24 px: a 1.5 px seam on a 4 px lattice pitch leaves ≈ 2.5 px of fill per facet, so 5–11 facets with three fill tiers and one 'lit facet' become stroke mush; this also contradicts E.6's own finding that 'facets become noise below 40 px'.
issues.fix: Two artwork levels per glyph: `size=24` uses lattice pitch 5 px (4 rows × 8 cells), 3–6 facets, 1 px seam, two tiers only (one lit facet + charcoal); `size=48` uses the full spec (pitch 8 px, 5–11 facets, 1.5 px seam, three tiers). Export both as paths in the same component behind a `size` prop (≈ 0.7 KB each).

issues.problem: Ambiguity about how many LowPolyScene instances exist. E.3 says 'one rAF per scene', E.5 says 'every other scene's <noscript> holds its state poster', while §06's continuous morph and the keyframe table imply one pinned full-viewport canvas for the home journey. This decides how textSafeZones, logoExclusion, posters and IntersectionObserver gating work, and other sections (D, F, J) cannot interface without it.
issues.fix: State it: the home route has exactly one pinned, full-viewport LowPolyScene (`position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 0`) owned by SceneController; sections scroll over it and update `setTextSafeZones`/`logoExclusion` via the handle per section. Secondary LowPolyScene instances exist only on feature-detail routes and the 404, each with its own poster. The IntersectionObserver gating applies to those secondary instances only.

issues.problem: §05 'triangles should subtly rotate' is delivered on HIGH only; because `pointer: coarse → MEDIUM` and `hardwareConcurrency ≤ 4 → MEDIUM`, every tablet (including iPad Pro), every phone and many laptops never see facets rotate — the rotation is cheap (it is part of the same corner lerp once `cpos` exists) so the cut is unjustified.
issues.fix: Per-triangle rotation on HIGH (±1.5°) and MEDIUM (±1.0°, 0.08 Hz, updated at 30 Hz); off on LOW; zero in REDUCED_MOTION.

issues.problem: `depth` prop: 'Scales z range (0–0.35 vh of displacement)' is a unit error — 0.35 vh is ≈ 3 px. Beam lift radius '140 px' and lens/orbit sizes are absolute px on a system otherwise specified in vh.
issues.fix: Write `depth` as 'z range 0–0.35 × viewport height (0–315 px at 900 px tall)'. Express the beam lift radius as 14 vh (desktop) / 11 vh (mobile), and the `lighter` cap as the nearest 24 facets.

issues.problem: Accent-field formula is underspecified: `noise(centroid·k)` has no `k`; 'ridged fBm correlated with the state's z-field' does not say how; the specular test needs a view vector that is never defined.
issues.fix: `accentField = 0.6·ridge(z_centroid) + 0.4·fbm3(centroid × 3.5, seed)`; a facet is accent iff `accentField > 1 − accentShare`. Specular: `V = (0, 0, 1)`, `H = normalize(L + V)`, lift when `acos(n·H) < 10°`.

issues.problem: Icon concepts are largely stock iconography (padlock, megaphone, open book, clapper, speech bubble, head-and-shoulders, shield-with-check) — the lattice makes them a family, but the ideas could sit in any icon set; only the crown notch ties to the logo.
issues.fix: Derive at least six glyphs from the mark itself: Chat AI = the V-sign's two raised facets with the speech tail; Agent AI = the crown's five points as a 5-stub node; Human Talent AI = the open palm's thumb facet over the base plate; Automation AI = the V repeated as a zig-zag; Privacy & Security = the base plate as a closed slab with the crown notch; Truth & Verify = a single raised finger facet with the beam slash. Keep the others but drop the megaphone (use three widening beam lines).

issues.problem: Profile heuristic details: `navigator.getBattery` is deprecated and Chromium-only; 'viewport area × DPR > 4.5 MP' mixes units (CSS area × DPR²); `prefers-reduced-motion` is read once and persisted in `sessionStorage`, so a user toggling the OS setting mid-session is ignored; the 'Enable motion' override lives in the footer, which a reduced-motion user on a long cinematic page may never reach.
issues.fix: Drop the battery check. Use `cssWidth × cssHeight × DPR² > 4.5 MP`. Subscribe to `matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').addEventListener('change', …)` and re-run `pickProfile` on change. Expose the motion toggle in the nav/skip overlay as well as the footer (coordinate with section K).

issues.problem: DPR cap 1.5 on HIGH means a Retina laptop (DPR 2) renders at 75 % and upscales; the `1/DPR px` seam becomes a 0.67 px anti-aliased stroke that shimmers against the ±2 px breathing.
issues.fix: HIGH DPR cap = 2 when `cssArea × DPR² ≤ 4.5 MP`, else 1.5; seam width = `max(1, 1/DPR)` device px, drawn on half-pixel-aligned coordinates.

issues.problem: Drift guard 'pixel diff ≤ 1 %' between a Canvas raster and a browser-rendered SVG will fail on anti-aliasing differences along ~2,000 hairline seams, and the posters are listed as Milestone 1 deliverables although they depend on the Milestone 3 state generators.
issues.fix: Compare per-triangle: the test asserts identical `(centroid, quantised colour, band)` tuples between the live LOW/MEDIUM frame and the SVG `<polygon>` data, plus an SSIM ≥ 0.97 on the raster. Move `scripts/generate-posters.ts` and `public/posters/*` to Milestone 3; Milestone 1 ships tokens, Logo, icons, grain and a placeholder MOUNTAIN poster.

issues.problem: Tokens in `styles/tokens.css` are not bridged to Tailwind, so utility classes and the canvas could still drift; `palette` prop lacks an explicit value for the hub; the LIVE indicator 'pulses by tier change' with no reduced-motion rule; the `--mist` note claims the logo backdrop is warm (it is neutral 237/237/237).
issues.fix: `tailwind.config.ts` colours reference the CSS variables (`graphite: 'var(--graphite)'`), and `lib/lowpoly/palette.ts` is generated from `tokens.css` by a script so there is one source. Add `palette: 'full'` as the documented value for CHAT + SHAKIR ONE. LIVE pulse: static tier-A dot under REDUCED_MOTION. Delete the 'warm backdrop' justification for `--mist`.
